results.title: Michael Hiltzik: Sure, use Meta's Muse bot to help with your chores — if you want Mark Zuckerberg to know all your secrets
results.description: If Silicon Valley has perfected any business model, it's the one in which it cooks up a new technology and then persuades people they can't live without it. The newest example is Meta Platforms' personal artificial intelligence agent, Muse. Something…
